Evidence_Note: RRT prevalence 294.3/million (2021) is the only sourced PMP figure; a separate GaStat/MoH dataset independently reports 20,440 HD patients for the same year (SRC-SAU-BMCPH-2024) — the two HD counts (20,534 vs 20,440) are close but not identical, from different underlying datasets, and are NOT reconciled into one number here.

Two inconsistent PMP figures exist from different sources/years: ESRD prevalence 152/million (MOHAP, 2017) vs HD prevalence ~370/million (IJNRD 2024, citing an older estimate with growth up to 15%/yr, though recent local Abu Dhabi/SEHA data suggest growth has slowed to ~6-7%/yr). A separate figure of long-term KRT prevalence 201.4/million is also cited (ISN Global Kidney Health Atlas 2021, via SRC-ARE-IJNRD-2024). No patient headcount located — converting any of these rates to a count would require applying our own population denominator, i.e. would become DERIVED, not OBSERVED, so left blank.

HD_Units (197) is HD dialysis STATIONS, not hospital departments — flagged so it is not misread. Overall dialysis (HD+PD) = 1,150 patients (900 HD + 250 PD), all under the single Hamad Medical Corporation system. Crude adult dialysis prevalence reported as 697.24 per million population (13.3% YoY rise, 2022).
